user.title: Smartcar credentials
user.description:
Enter the three values from your Smartcar dashboard.

The **Application ID** is shown on the application's overview page. The **Client ID** and **Client Secret** are on the *API Credentials* tab. These are separate values.

Make sure your Home Assistant's redirect URI `{redirect_url}` is registered under *Authorized redirect URIs* on the application page before continuing.

webhooks.title: Webhooks (optional)
webhooks.description:
Webhooks let Smartcar push vehicle data to Home Assistant in real time instead of relying on polling.

If you want to use webhooks, paste your **Application Management Token** from the Smartcar dashboard. You'll get the callback URL to register on Smartcar after setup completes.
